chunks: He said: Abul Hasan Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Walid reported to me from his father, from Sa‘d ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Bakr ibn Salih, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Abdullah ibn Ibrahim, who said: al-Husayn ibn Zayd narrated to me, from Ja‘far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his grandfather, peace be upon them, who said:

The Messenger of God, may God bless him and his family and grant them peace, said: When I was taken on the Night Journey to the heavens and I reached the Lote Tree of the Farthest Boundary, I was called: 'O Muhammad, take good care of Ali, for indeed he is the master of the Muslims, the Imam of the God-fearing, and the leader of those with radiant faces and illuminated limbs on the Day of Resurrection.'

key_terms.أسري: Isra'/Night Journey — refers to the miraculous night journey of the Prophet, referenced in Quran 17:1
key_terms.استوص: Counsel/take good care — an imperative commanding special treatment and regard
key_terms.الغر المحجلين: Those with radiant faces and illuminated limbs — a metaphor for people marked by the light of ablution (wudu) on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.سدرة المنتهى: Sidrat al-Muntaha — the Lote Tree of the Farthest Boundary, the highest point the Prophet reached during Mi'raj (referenced in Quran 53:14)

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about Ali during the Night Journey (Mi'raj)?
ai.summary: The Prophet (SAWW) recounts that during his ascension to the heavens (Mi'raj), upon reaching Sidrat al-Muntaha — the farthest boundary of the created universe — he received a divine command to take good care of Imam Ali (AS). The divine voice declared Ali's three exalted stations: master of all Muslims, leader of the God-conscious, and guide of those who will shine with radiance on the Day of Judgment. This hadith is from the Amali of al-Shaykh al-Mufid and establishes Ali's divinely ordained leadership.
word_analysis: I was taken on a night journey

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 3. He said: Abul Hasan Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibnal-Hasan ibn al-Walid reported to me from his father, from Sa’d ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Bakr ibn Swaleh, from al-Hasan ibn ‘Ali, from Abdullah ibn Ibrahim, who reported from al-Husayn ibn Zaid, from Ja’far ibn Muhammad, reporting from his father and his grandfather, peace be upon them, that:

The Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, said: The night I was taken to the heavens, I ended up at Sidratul Muntaha, I heard: "O Muhammad, counsel (your people) good about ‘Ali, for he is the master of the Muslims, Imam of the people of Taqwa (those who guard themselves from all sins), and leader of the hopping horses with white spots on their foreheads (leading to the Paradise), on the Day of Judgement."
